name: metrics-reporter
description: Turns a weekly SaaS metrics CSV into a week-over-week growth report with activation rate, churn trend, and dollar-quantified incident callouts.
runtime_notes: lib/managed.ts: in outcome mode, the deliverable is often emitted as an intermediate agent.message, followed by a short wrap-up message once the grader reports satisfied — consumeUntilEndTurn returned strictly the last message, which clobbered the deliverable with the wrap-up. Fixed by tracking the longest agent.message seen and preferring it over the last one, gated to invocation === 'outcome' (message mode keeps last-message semantics). Also confirmed client.beta.files.list({scope_id}) 400s on the live API despite the SDK's type declaration, and sandbox files written during a session are not registered in the Files API at all — there is currently no way to retrieve a sandbox-written file after the fact; the reply-message stream is the only channel.
